# ttvl.co

> The public notebook and project archive of Toto Tvalavadze, a software engineer, fine-art photographer, gallery curator, and independent interface researcher. It covers analog photography and the darkroom, bookbinding, notebook systems, humane interfaces and tools for thought, Obsidian tools, writing, and walking.

Everything published on ttvl.co is written by Toto. He uses AI privately, for example to draft the monthly log from his journal and to proofread, but the published text is his own; [AI on ttvl.co](/ai/) and [The Human Border](/notes/the-human-border/) explain the line.

The site has six kinds of content. Projects document things he made: printable darkroom and bindery tools with STL and PDF downloads, command-line tools and Obsidian plugins (code on GitHub), and notebook systems. Notes are essays and opinions. Research is a dated working journal of what was tried, found, or asked, in numbered entries per stream, without arguments. The Log is a monthly summary of what he made and did, since January 2019. The Flâneur is his occasional newsletter. Traces are records of places: 3D scans, photographs, and maps.

URLs follow fixed patterns: `/log/YYYY/MM/` for a Log month, `/flaneur/NNN/` for a newsletter issue, and `/research/<stream>/<slug>/` for a research entry. Pages are published as HTML only. This guide was last reviewed on 2026-10-14; `/sitemap.xml` lists every page.

## Start Here

- [About](/about/): Toto's background, principles, record of books, exhibitions, programs and press, and how to get in touch.
- [Projects](/projects/): Every documented project, by year, from four hubs: Project Humane, Obsidian, Darkroom, and Bookbinding.
- [Notes](/notes/): Essays and shorter notes, labelled Collected, Thinking, or Longform.
- [Research](/research/): The working journal, in two streams.
- [Log](/log/): Monthly summaries of what was made and done.
- [The Flâneur](/newsletter/): The newsletter's archive of dispatches about work, photography, books, making, and walking.
- [Traces](/traces/): Records of places: scans, photographs, documents, and maps.

## Projects

- [Project Humane](/project-humane/): Tools for thought and interfaces made for human bodies and durable files.
- [Plaintext Commons](/project-humane/plaintext-commons/): Manifesto for keeping long-form knowledge in durable, human- and agent-friendly plain-text files.
- [Unbound Notebook System](/project-humane/notebook-system/): Loose-leaf notebook framework that joins analog thinking with digital retrieval.
- [Copy Editor](/project-humane/copy-editor/): Local AI writing tool that suggests edits beside a draft and leaves every change to the writer.
- [Arrowhead CLI](/obsidian/arrowhead/): Search, graph, context, metric, and automation tools for Markdown vaults, for people and agents.
- [Obsidian](/obsidian/): Hub of Obsidian plugins and vault tools.
- [Darkroom](/darkroom/): Analog photography processes, equipment modifications, printable tools, and manuals.
- [Film Identification Format](/darkroom/roll-id/): A compact way to identify and track film rolls.
- [Bookbinding](/bookbinding/): Bindery fixtures, experiments, and practice notes.
- [Jinny Street Gallery](/jinny/): Outdoor contemporary art space made from streetlamp display cases in Jingumae, Tokyo, which Toto co-founded in 2023.

## Notes

- [The Human Border](/notes/the-human-border/): A line between AI assistance and authorship.
- [Where I Stand on AI—For Now](/notes/where-i-stand-on-ai/): Toto's position on using artificial intelligence.
- [Ship the tool, not the agent](/notes/ship-the-tool-not-the-agent/): Build a capability as a clear tool that people and agents can both drive, rather than wrapping it in a single-purpose agent.
- [Software gets malleable when describing it is enough](/notes/software-gets-malleable/): Why describing behavior to a model makes small, specific software worth building.
- [Hands Are Not Cursors](/notes/hands-are-not-cursors/): Notes on embodied interaction.
- [The Silo Problem in Photography](/notes/non-photographers-need-not-apply/): Why photography books and platforms struggle to reach beyond photographers.
- [Walking](/notes/walking/): Why walking matters to Toto's thinking and photography.

## Research

- [Ambient Computing](/research/ambient-computing/): Dynamicland-style computing in the studio, with the room as the interface: screens, keys, voice, paper, and hands.
- [Tools for Thought](/research/tools-for-thought/): Plain-text systems, notebooks, and software that helps people think with files they own.

## Feeds

- [RSS feed](/index.xml): Full text of Log, Notes, newsletter, and project entries.
- [Research feed](/research/index.xml): Entries from both research streams.

## Optional

- [Rapid Travel Film Development Kit](/darkroom/travel-dev-kit/): Portable film-development workflow.
- [VNS Film-Scanning Adapter](/darkroom/valoi-easy120-with-negative-supply-99cri-light/): Adapter joining a Valoi Easy120 carrier to a Negative Supply light source.
- [Bulk Film Canister Stickers](/darkroom/canister-stickers/): Printable labeling system for bulk-loaded film.
- [Foldable Film Reminders](/darkroom/foldable-film-reminder/): Printable reminders of which film is loaded in each camera.
- [Rugged 40-Roll Film Storage](/darkroom/rugged-40-roll-film-storage/): 3D-printable film holders for any roll film format.
- [Horseman 80 mm² Lensboards](/darkroom/horseman-lensboards/): 3D-printable lensboards for any lens.
- [Mamiya RZ67 PRO II Fine Focus Gear](/darkroom/rz67-focus-gear-stl/): 3D-printable replacement gear for fine focus.
- [Thermometer Panel for Jobo Systems](/darkroom/thermometer-panel-for-jobo-systems/): 3D-printable panel for temperature monitoring and control.
- [Zone Placement Sticker for Pentax Digital Spotmeter](/darkroom/pentax-digital-spotmeter-sticker/): DIY replica of Ansel Adams' zone scale.
- [Lucky CP32 Manual](/darkroom/lucky-cp32-manual/): Original Japanese manual and an English translation.
- [Corner Cutting Jig](/bookbinding/corner-cutting-jig/): Six printable jigs for cutting book-board corners.
- [Patchcord](/project-humane/patchcord/): Agent-friendly development, deployment, and debugging workflow for CircuitPython projects.
- [Refmode CLI](/project-humane/refmode/): macOS command-line tool for switching Apple display reference modes.
- [Things CLI](/project-humane/things-cli/): macOS command-line access to Things 3.
- [TP-7 CLI](/project-humane/tp7/): File management for Teenage Engineering TP-7 recorders.
- [Whoopy CLI](/project-humane/whoopy/): Unofficial WHOOP data CLI for people, automation, dashboards, and agents.
- [Withingy CLI](/project-humane/withingy/): Withings activity, sleep, and workout data from the terminal.
- [EDC Modular Keychain](/project-humane/edc-keychain/): Lightweight, modular everyday-carry system.
- [Better Kanban Bases View](/obsidian/bases-kanban-view/): Kanban view for Obsidian Bases.
- [Metrics](/obsidian/metrics/): View, edit, validate, and chart plain-text metric files in Obsidian.
- [Stamp CLI](/obsidian/stamp/): Consistent filenames for humans, agents, and automation.
- [Triage](/obsidian/triage/): Anki-style queue for resurfacing unprocessed notes.
- [Vault Tasks](/obsidian/vault-tasks/): Vault-wide Markdown task view.
- [Jinny Street Gallery Website](/jinny-website/): The gallery's website, with a 3D neighborhood map, an exhibition archive, and tools for its artists.
- [Loose Leaves](/leaves/): Scans of pages from the Unbound Notebook System, newest first.
- [A Spatial Long Exposure](/traces/spatial-long-exposure/): Map of accumulated location history and geotagged photographs, without individual dates.
- [Kyojima Studio, 2024–2026](/traces/kyojima-studio/): 3D scan and photographs of the studio.
- [Wirescapes at Mutant Radio](/traces/wirescapes-mutant-radio/): 3D scan and photographs of the Wirescapes reprise in Tbilisi.
- [Square sensors make sense for online video](/notes/square-sensors/): Square video that carries suggested crops or points of interest.
- [Universal Content Bundle](/notes/universal-content-bundle/): Self-describing bundle format for content readable by humans, software, and agents.
- [Stop Saying Russian When You Mean Soviet](/notes/soviet-not-russia/): Cultural and historical observations from a Georgian perspective.
- [Colophon](/colophon/): How the site is built and published, its type, and privacy.
- [Search index](/index.json): JSON of every section page with its title, section, date, summary, and full text; About and other root pages are not included.
